Subject: Postdoc at UC Berkeley to work on spatial modeling of climate and landuse change

Sorry for the impersonal post!

I've got a great postdoc opportunity for the right person with strong quantitative skills in Bayesian multispecies occupancy models, spatial modeling and analyses of large data sets to work with me and the Grinnell Resurvey data to understand the effects of a century of global change on California birds and forecast the future impacts of climate and land-use change.

See attached below.   Feel free to distribute widely.

Best,

 Steve
